newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 25.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - An outbreak of African swine fever in April 1996 is still costing the country some 200 million CFA francs ($320,000) per month -- the cost of importing foreign pork. Some 4,000 jobs have been lost and many producers have yet to be compensated. LE JOUR - The government is stepping up its efforts to clean the country's beaches. Companies are being stopped from dumping refuse on coastal areas, and public toilets are being installed. (1$=615 CFA francs) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
